source.attribution: Reports retrieved from Bundesanzeiger via the bundesAPI deutschland package.

access.note: Queries the public Bundesanzeiger search and solves a captcha via a bundled ML model. Effectively rate-limited; per-company only; do not bulk-scrape.

pagination.note: One call per company name; returns all found reports as a dict. Go implementation would need to port the search+captcha flow or shell out to the Python tool.

transport.rate_limit: captcha-gated; keep volume low (community guidance for the official portal is <=60 lookups/hour)

snapshot.note: Persist {report_title: content} per queried company; downstream extractor derives figures.

parsing.notes: Content is HTML/full-text, NOT XBRL. Parse period from the German title; run an HTML/table extractor for numeric line items. Filter titles to Jahresabschluss/Bilanz.

mapping_rules.documents: Each report -> a documents[]/filing entry with report_type + fiscal_period.
mapping_rules.financial_statements: Only after extracting figures from report_content; map to financial_statements[] with source='bundesanzeiger_reports'.
mapping_rules.matching: Name-based query; resolve to the registry spine by name+seat before attaching.

fixture_requirements: get_reports() result with at least one Jahresabschluss title + HTML content
company with multiple yearly reports (multi-entry dict)
ambiguous common name returning unrelated companies
report whose content is HTML tables (exercise the figure extractor)

live_test_plan.smoke: Query one well-known company name; assert a 'Jahresabschluss …' key exists and content is non-empty.
live_test_plan.full: For a bounded set of target companies (NOT the whole population), query throttled behind an env gate; persist raw dicts; extract figures; respect portal terms and captcha limits.

blockers: Captcha/rate-limited and unofficial — not viable for bulk ingestion.
Returns HTML/text, not structured XBRL — needs a figure-extraction layer.
Name-based matching to the registry spine is ambiguous.
Native tool is Python; a Go implementation must port or shell out.
